arxiv-1805-04177.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by R.Zuyeuski. The muon telescopes of the Extreme Energy Events (EEE) experiment are based on Multigap Resistive Plate Chambers (MRPC). arxiv-2202-10617.title: An Ensemble Learning Framework for Vehicle Trajectory Prediction in Interactive Scenarios*
arxiv-2202-10617.creator: Zirui Li, Yunlong Lin, Cheng Gong, Student Member IEEE, Xinwei Wang, Qi Liu, Jianwei Gong, Member IEEE, Chao Lu, Member IEEE
arxiv-2202-10617.description: Abstract Precisely modeling interactions and accurately predicting trajectories of surrounding vehicles are essential to the decision-making and path-planning of intelligent vehicles. This paper proposes a novel framework based on ensemble learning to improve the performance of trajectory predictions in interactive scenarios. The framework is termed Interactive Ensemble Trajectory Predictor (IETP).

arxiv-2206-07925.title: SME Gravity in the Early Universe
arxiv-2206-07925.creator: N.A.Nilsson
arxiv-2206-07925.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by N.A.Nilsson. In this talk, we give a short overview of recent work on cosmological solutions within the SME gravitational sector under the assumption of explicit spacetime-symmetry breaking. We show that for the special case of timelike diffeomorphism breaking, the resulting Friedmann equations can be written as standard FLRW cosmology with added dynamical dark energy, and we discuss primordial gravitational waves in the context of this model.

arxiv-2405-17873.description: Abstract Few-step diffusion models, which enable high-quality text-to-image generation with only a few denoising steps, have substantially reduced inference time. However, considerable memory consumption (5-10GB) still poses limitations for practical deployment on mobile devices. arxiv-2406-18901.description: Abstract Deep neural networks (DNNs) have exhibited remarkable performance across various tasks, yet their susceptibility to spurious correlations poses a significant challenge for out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. pmc-11637293.title: Identifying and quantifying potentially problematic prescribing cascades in clinical practice: A mixed‐methods study

In the cells, copper may exist in the Cu+ and Cu++ oxidation states and the interconversion between these two states may occur via various redox reactions regulating cellular respiration, energy metabolism, and cell growth.

pmc-13072940.creator: Tsunehisa Sato, Rolf Schreckenberg, Klaus-Dieter Schlüter
pmc-13072940.description: Low physical activity is a common risk factor for hypertension and dementia.
